label: rectifyesvalidation.vercel.app
title: EVM Resolve
reasons: The page uses the Coinbase Wallet SDK and WalletConnect to prompt the user to connect their wallet via a 'CONNECT' button, which redirects to '/connect/index.html'.

The page's copy describes 'test transactions' and 'gas refunds' as part of a 'project rectification protocol (PRP)', which are common lures in wallet drainer scams that trick users into approving malicious transactions.
The page disables right-click and key combinations for inspection (F12, Ctrl+U, etc.), a common anti-forensic technique in malicious pages.

label: mutiarabonusdana.vercel.app

label: cryptojacking.vercel.app
